input.quote: (vi) Return of Materials. Within ninety (90) days after the end of the Wind-down Period, upon request by Array, Ono shall either deliver to Array or destroy all tangible items comprising, bearing or containing trademarks of Array (including the Product Trademarks), trade names, patents, copyrights, designs, drawings, formulas or other Data, photographs, samples, literature, sales and promotional aids ("Product Materials") and Confidential Information of Array, that is in Ono's possession, subject to Ono's right to keep one (1) copy for archiving purposes.
input.rationale: Article XIV is a detailed wind-down regime, but every operative transition and return obligation runs against us: Ono must transition studies (p0646-p0647), continue distribution, assign Regulatory Filings and hand over all Data and Ono Know-How (p0659), grant back licences (p0661), return or destroy Array's Materials and Confidential Information (p0662), and assign marks, domains and Sublicences (p0665-p0666). The only mutual language is the general cooperation covenant in Section 14.2(a)(iv) (p0660), which is limited to transitioning the Product back to Array during the Wind-down Period. There is no obligation anywhere (Article X contains no return/destruction clause and no other paragraph mentions "destroy") for Array to return or delete Ono's Data or Confidential Information, and no committed transition assistance or continued supply for Ono during wind-down. That fails even the fallback (90 days' assistance plus data export within 30 days), so we insert a reciprocal Section 14.2(a)(x): six months' transition assistance including continued Article IX supply while we must keep distributing, return of our Data and Confidential Information in machine-readable form within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter (carving out the Data and Know-How Array is licensed to use under 14.2(a)(iii), (v) and (ix), which is the agreed commercial bargain and is not reopened).

ops.text: (x) Array Transition Assistance; Return of Ono Confidential Information. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Array shall (A) at Ono's request, provide reasonable transition assistance to Ono for a period of up to six (6) months, including continuing to supply Materials on the terms of Article IX for so long as Ono is required to distribute the Product under Section 14.2(a)(ii); (B) within thirty (30) days after Ono's written request, return to Ono, in a commonly used, machine-readable format, all Data and other Confidential Information of Ono in Array's possession or control (other than Data and Ono Know-How that Array is licensed or otherwise entitled to use pursuant to Section 14.2(a)(iii), (v) or (ix)); and (C) thereafter delete or destroy all remaining copies of such Confidential Information of Ono in its systems and certify such deletion or destruction to Ono in writing, subject to Array's right to keep one (1) copy for archiving purposes.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article XIV currently runs only in Array's favour, so we have added a reciprocal exit provision: on termination Array provides us up to six (6) months of transition assistance (including continued supply while we remain obliged to distribute Product) and returns our Data and Confidential Information within thirty (30) days, then certifies deletion. This is our standard transition and data-return position; we can accept ninety (90) days of assistance if Array prefers.
proposal.summary: Insert reciprocal Array transition-assistance and return/deletion of Ono Confidential Information as new Section 14.2(a)(x)
